verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm, a professional services provider rather than a software product. A user-facing telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is not a fair comparison axis for this kind of product. Its client tools (trademark extranet, AI review tools, dashboards) and its privacy legal practice are adjacent, and nothing in the pack shows the firm ships any telemetry opt-out control that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
